kohs_anchors.screen.title: KoHs Anchor's
kohs_anchors.screen.subtitle: Anchor and glowstone, exactly as you pressed them
kohs_anchors.option.input_order.descript: When use and hotbar keys land in the same tick, they are applied in the order you pressed them, and the last key you pressed stays selected. Vanilla applies every number key first, and hotbar order mods pick one on their own, so a fast place, glowstone, detonate could use the wrong item.
kohs_anchors.option.fresh_target.descrip: A second use in the same tick, after you switched items, aims at what your crosshair hits after the first one, like the anchor you just placed, instead of the block that was there before. A repeat with the same item keeps its target, so it never stacks an anchor.
kohs_anchors.option.predict_detonation.d: The explosion's sound and flash play the moment you press use, not a tick or a round trip later. The block, damage and knockback still come from the server.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debris.descri: Block debris particles of anchor explosions. Turning them off saves frames in anchor fights; other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.interface_motion.des: Floating particles, entrance effects and the animated anchor on this screen.
kohs_anchors.stats.title: This session
kohs_anchors.footer.note: Every action is your own click. The server decides.
kohs_anchors.preview.hint: Drag: turn · Wheel: zoom · Click: charge
kohs_anchors.option.hold_early_clicks.de: A click on an anchor you just detonated, made before the server has removed it, waits and lands the moment the block is free, instead of being spent on the old anchor. Place the next one without waiting to see the explosion. Clicking again with the same item joins the waiting click instead of stacking another anchor.
kohs_anchors.option.no_stacking.descript: A second click with the same item in the same tick is a double click. With anchors it can only fail or, on grass, snow or the fire an explosion leaves, stack a second anchor on the first, so it joins the first one. Charging with glowstone is not limited.
kohs_anchors.advanced.banner.title: Not secure: you decide
kohs_anchors.advanced.banner.text: These options change when your clicks reach the server. Anticheats such as Grim can flag them and many servers forbid them. Check your server's rules before switching one on.
kohs_anchors.option.hide_detonating.desc: The anchor you detonate disappears the moment you click, instead of standing there until the server's explosion arrives. Drawing only: the block, its collision and what the server sees do not change.
kohs_anchors.option.fast_chain.descripti: Clicks on an exploding anchor are sent at once instead of waiting for the server to remove it, and the next anchor, its charge and its explosion are drawn at once. Glowstone that would land as a block and anchors that would stack are dropped.
kohs_anchors.option.instant_detonation.d: A click that detonates an anchor is sent the moment you press it, remapped key or mouse, instead of on the next game tick (up to 50 ms sooner). Vanilla never sends a click between ticks.
kohs_anchors.warning.title: YOU ARE WARNED
kohs_anchors.warning.subtitle: "%s" is not secure
kohs_anchors.warning.body: It changes when your clicks reach the server. Anticheats such as Grim may flag it and many servers forbid it: you could be kicked or banned. Check whether its use is allowed on the server you are playing on before you continue.
kohs_anchors.warning.activated.sub: Only where your server allows it.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.advanced: Not secure: you decide, the server rules.
